## What changed

- `kmctl review due --base REF` lists only what the branch made due since it
  split from `REF`: a source the branch changed, a page it added or edited,
  and the summary when the branch changed a concept the summary lists. A ref
  git cannot compare with `HEAD` exits 2 (ADR 0055, #72).
- `kmctl verify ID ID ... --by human:<id>` verifies several pages in one
  command. It checks every id before it writes any file, so one refused id
  writes nothing. `--json` prints one object per id, one per line (ADR 0055,
  #72).
- A `kmctl verify` no longer puts the summary behind. A change that touches
  only `verified` and `stale_after` is not a concept change for the summary.
  Accepting a draft still counts (ADR 0054, #72).
- `kmctl check --summary-current` fails when the summary is behind its
  concepts. The CI action has a new input, `summary`. The default, `fail`,
  passes that flag. `pass` only warns, as before. A local `kmctl check` and
  the pre-commit hook still only warn (ADR 0056, #72).
- On a pull request, the CI action's job summary first lists the pages that
  pull request made due (#72).
- The knowledge rules and the audit skill name `kmctl review due --base` and
  the multi-id `kmctl verify` (#72).
- The starter's `ci.yml` and `apm.yml` keep an anchor comment below each
  kmctl pin. A project's own CI steps, jobs, APM dependencies or `mcp:` block
  added below that comment no longer conflict on `just upgrade`. `just kmctl`,
  `just install` and `just install-frozen` refuse while git holds unmerged
  files, and name them (ADR 0053, #68).

## Before you upgrade

- The CI action now fails a pull request whose `.okf/summary.md` is behind
  its concepts. If the summary on your default branch is behind, the next
  pull request fails until someone updates the summary or runs
  `kmctl summary ack`. Run `kmctl check` on the default branch first. To
  keep the old behaviour, set `summary: pass` on the action.
- A script that reads `kmctl verify --json` still gets one JSON object for
  one id. For several ids it gets one object per line.
- A project script that filters `kmctl review due` by branch can be
  replaced with `kmctl review due --base origin/main`.
- A project made from the starter before this release conflicts once in
  `ci.yml` and `apm.yml`, on the upgrade that brings the anchors in.
  `just upgrade` now stops and names the files. Keep the new ref, and put
  your own content below the anchor comment.

## Other changes

None.

## Install

```sh
uv tool install git+https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.17.0#subdirectory=packages/kmctl
```

In a workflow:

```yaml
- uses: JasperHG90/kmctl@v0.17.0
```

**Full diff**: https://github.com/JasperHG90/kmctl/compare/v0.16.1...v0.17.0
